body:
From Claude: Pete asked me to open this so the land model's RMSE values are saved as data, which gives a time series of them across runs, and I wrote the change.

`compute_seasonal_leaderboard` builds time-averaged simulation and observation maps for each variable and season, and the global RMSE and bias of those maps only appear in the plots. This also writes `<data source>_leaderboard_rmse.csv` next to the plots (`ERA5_leaderboard_rmse.csv` and `ILAMB_leaderboard_rmse.csv`), one row per variable and season:

```
short_name,season,data_source,rmse,bias,units
lhf,ANN,ERA5,10.3,-1.2,"W m^-2"
```

The same table is printed to the job log, since Buildkite ages artifacts out sooner than logs and it's only about 50 rows per data source.

The values come from `ClimaAnalysis.global_rmse` and `ClimaAnalysis.global_bias` on the same land-masked, time-averaged maps the seasonal plots use, so they match the RMSE and bias in the figure titles and are ClimaLand's own RMSE definition. Seasons without data are `NaN`. `rmse_boxplots.jl` isn't touched, so this doesn't overlap with #1897.

The long-run jobs that make leaderboard plots (Snowy Land + P Model, its optimal-LAI variant, the 19-year versions of both, and the global bucket run) only upload `*png`, so this adds a `*csv` glob to their `artifact_paths`.

[clima-perf](https://github.com/petebachant/clima-perf) mirrors the weekly `climaland-long-runs` jobs, so with these numbers it can build a time series of each RMSE and bias instead of them being read off the plots by hand. Nothing else changes; the plots are the same.

Testing: after merging main, I ran `write_rmses` on synthetic lon/lat/time fields with a known uniform offset and some missing cells, passed through `_land_intersection_mask` and time-averaged as in the leaderboard, plus a season with no data. The RMSE, bias, and `NaN` values are as expected, and the logged table matches the file. I haven't run the long-run leaderboard locally. JuliaFormatter 2.10.1 makes no changes.

title: Write seasonal leaderboard RMSEs to CSV artifacts
